headline: Binance Suffers Record $6.3 Billion Crypto Heist
summary: Cryptocurrency exchange Binance suffered an estimated $6.3 billion hack, described as the largest heist in digital asset history. The exchange vowed to reopen within a couple of days.
why: Binance is the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume, making major security breaches systemic events that can trigger widespread panic and regulatory scrutiny across the entire digital asset sector.
why_moved: A security breach of $6.3 billion at the world's largest crypto exchange rattled investor confidence and disrupted platform operations.
